summary: W18 is the peak load week of the Build (~21 mi, §4.D) and the second full v4.4 three-run week: Mon LONG 65 min / Tue Hyp A / Wed T 4×1 mi / Thu OFF / Fri VO2 8×800m @ I / Sat Hyp B lift-only / Sun OFF. It opens against a short W17: the Sat 8-15 VO2 5×1000m @ I was MISSED and there is no make-up — Sun is off by rule under v4.4 and W18 opened on Monday's long, so the session is dropped, not repaid (§11.D, same posture as Adj #214/#233/#250). W17 closed at 2 runs (~13.1 mi) + 2 lifts against a ~20 mi peak target, with both lifts and both remaining runs banked in full and the entire loss on the VO2 — the first outright-missed quality session of the Build, where the three prior weeks each lost easy or long volume instead. In a three-run week that is a third of the running and half the quality (Adj #282). MONDAY DELIVERED IN FULL: 65:00 / 6.50 mi @ 9:59/mi plus a 0.20 mi walked cooldown, the second consecutive long banked in its programmed slot and again the week's entire easy fraction. It also closed the Adj #256 watch — the deliberate sub-band pickup from the W17 long did not repeat: the session average sits mid-band 25 s/mi slower than W17's 9:34, and average power 200 W runs under every in-band mile of that long but one and 32 W under its 232/233 W pickup miles, an aggregate that cannot hide a sustained fast segment. Cadence 168 is inside the 165–172 easy allowance; HR 169 and power are display-only; RPE and mile splits n/r (Adj #283). Monday was also the first run after Friday's seated-calf 365 sweep, at ~66 h: the compressed Saturday Achilles gate never ran because the VO2 was missed, so the read reverted to exactly the ~66 h Z1 shape Adj #244/#249 designed and closed clean — 365's first exposure produced no Achilles signal at any read, the revert-to-355 branch is dead, and the calf holds 365 on Saturday to rebuild toward the full 4×12 (Adj #284). That leaves two loaded run days. Friday's 8×800m @ I is now the decisive band read: I has been unread since 8-9 and the walked-recovery confound has never been removed, so every term of the Adj #251/#252 ask carries over to a different shape but a fuller dose — open at the 7:00 fast end, 90 s JOG recoveries, ~28 min of work, RPE 9 governing. A second slip sends I into the W19 cut-down (Wed 8-26, §10) on nothing. Wednesday is the first outing at the stepped T band 7:40–7:45, opened on pace, with RPE 8+ or a died rep reverting to 7:45–7:50 on the spot (Adj #271). Tuesday is the busiest lift day of the cycle — three bumps fire at once: incline 160 (which owns §5 miss #1, so ≤RIR 1 reverts to 155 and <5 reps cuts the TM 5–7%), rear-delt 145, and DB lateral 35 at the full 6×12 with the opener-RIR gate retired (Adj #257/#258/#265). Tuesday and Saturday also carry reads 2 and 3 of the three full-dose pushdown back-half reads the Adj #264/#266 pause was bought to collect; two collapses out of two so far point the W19 Tue conversation at load or set count rather than at adding a second triceps movement (Adj #277).

days.note: Logged — 65:00 / 6.50 mi @ 9:59/mi + 0.20 mi walked CD (6.70 mi, 69:11). Delivered in full on the 65-min ask; second consecutive long in its programmed slot and the week's entire easy fraction. Adj #256 watch CLOSES — average mid-band, avg power 200 W under every in-band W17 mile but one and 32 W under its pickup miles, so the sub-band pickup did not repeat (Adj #283). Cadence 168 inside the 165–172 easy allowance; HR 169 avg and power display-only; RPE and mile splits n/r. Road, Vomero Plus; all clean by default — first run after the Fri 365 calf sweep at ~66 h, Achilles read CLOSED CLEAN, no revert (Adj #284).

THREE BUMPS FIRE: incline 160 (1×5 + AMRAP @ 135 — 160 owns §5 miss #1, ≤RIR 1 reverts 155, <5 reps cuts the TM 5–7%, Adj #257), rear-delt 145 (Adj #258), DB lateral 35 at the full 6×12 with the opener-RIR gate retired, reverting only if the front four can't hold 12 (Adj #265). Pushdown 27.5 is read 2 of the 3 the Adj #264/#266 pause buys — no 2nd-movement line until the W19 Tue brief 8-25 (Adj #277).

First outing at the stepped band 7:40–7:45, opened ON PACE — three consecutive sessions have opened fast and a 1-mile rep punishes it less forgivingly (Adj #268/#271). RPE ≤7 anchor governs and still holds the step: RPE 8+ or a died rep reverts to 7:45–7:50 on the spot. Feeds the W19 cut-down (Wed 8-26) that arbitrates T and I together.
